entries.name: AlphaFold 3
entries.description: Diffusion-based structure prediction model for biomolecular complexes, spanning proteins with DNA, RNA, small molecules, ions, and modified residues.
entries.citation: Accurate structure prediction of biomolecular interactions with AlphaFold 3

entries.name: RhoFold+
entries.description: End-to-end RNA 3D structure prediction from sequence alone, coupling the RNA-FM language model with an Invariant Point Attention structure module.
entries.citation: Accurate RNA 3D structure prediction using a language model-based deep learning approach

entries.name: OpenFold3
entries.description: Open-source Apache-2.0 reproduction of AlphaFold3 that predicts all-atom structures of proteins, RNA, DNA, small molecules, and their complexes.

entries.name: AlphaFold 2
entries.description: Protein structure prediction model that folds amino acid sequences into 3D structures with atomic accuracy, scoring a median GDT of 92.4 at CASP14.
entries.citation: Highly accurate protein structure prediction with AlphaFold

entries.name: ESMFold
entries.description: Protein structure prediction from a single sequence, with no multiple sequence alignment. Folds a 384-residue protein in 14.2 seconds on one GPU.
entries.citation: Evolutionary-scale prediction of atomic level protein structure with a language model

entries.name: RoseTTAFold
entries.description: Protein structure and complex prediction from sequence, in a three-track network that reasons over alignments, distances, and 3D coordinates at once.
entries.citation: Accurate prediction of protein structures and interactions using a 3-track neural network

note: bio.rodeo has no public API (checked 2026-10-17). Records are parsed from public model pages; fields may change without notice.
